data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Lissi is derived from the Greek word for 'liberation.' It is often associated with the goddess Hera, who symbolizes marriage, childbirth, and family. Lissi was believed to bring protection and guidance to women during labor, emphasizing the strength and resilience of the feminine spirit. The name Lissi carries the meaning “God's liberation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lissi usually hope their child will grow to embody god's liberation and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name has a rich history and continues to inspire feelings of strength and powerful femininity.
